behaviors.description: Adapt the original periodic 64-cubed noise, seven volume mip levels, independent low/middle/upper cloud shapes, wind shear and forward/back scattering to the continuous planet and shared wall-time sky. Clouds compose into the sky before terrain and appear in water reflection scene batches.
behaviors.selection: Initial authored three-layer fields use real-time wind and a gentle seasonal coverage bias. The original condensate/convection regional weather solver, rain, half-resolution HDR filtering and terrain cloud shadows are not yet ported. The native volumetric pass uses 24 samples per layer and two light probes; phone frame cost and visual parity remain unverified.

checks.expectation: Three cloud layers remain separate, world anchored, mip filtered and wind advected; sunset/night lighting matches the sky, camera motion and water reflections. No rain-only gate or opaque rectangular cloud plane appears.
checks.procedure: Validate all native shader modules and stage interfaces, cloud frame bounds and scene storage layout. Inspect live ground/horizon/sunset/night/water views and flight above and through cloud layers, including terrain ordering and phone performance. Metadata/shader checks do not establish rendered appearance, depth composition or frame cost.
